{"notes": "Visit 4 (6:00, about 60% of time used; 5:00-5:45 updates). The table is one continuous dark chain from the start, with no pale dominoes and no breaks. It runs up the body to the fork, along the top to the nose, back along the bottom line, and out to the lower tail lobe (x~28.5, y~16.6). The upper lobe reaches x~28.5, y~3.4. The fish looks complete and everything is connected to the start, so it should fall fully. I still can't see who placed which dominoes, so ratings rest on claims checked against the picture.

Leo: At 5:15 he said the lower lobe was down and connected, and the picture confirms it. He was the critical path and delivered after a silent stretch. He announced completion clearly, as Tom asked, and rechecked the join. Execution is solid and the earlier communication gap closed. Impact is likely good, since the lower lobe is a large piece, but I never saw him place it.

Tom: His earlier bottom-line claim held up. He gave a clear status and a clear handoff, and he asked Leo to shout when done. That is good coordination and leadership. His overall-run check is correct. He may have pre-built, which is still unknown.

Maya: She said the top lobe and the join near the start are connected, and the picture confirms both. She reported accurately and stayed hands-off to avoid bumps. Her impact is probable but not witnessed.

Priya: She said the nose joint is solid and the run carries, and the picture agrees. She was careful and supportive, and she credited Leo. I have still never seen what she built, so I'm asking her in the review what she placed.

Review: Everyone's statements matched the picture. Ask all four who built what. Hold the final impact scores until I hear their answers."}
